name: Council Investigate
summary: A multi-agent investigation workflow for absorption, design, or architecture decisions.

combo.description: Read-only mixed-model investigation with independent perspectives, synthesis, adversarial review, and final planning.

phases.title: Codex Scan
phases.action: Launch a read-only Codex scan over configured external mounts.
phases.verifier: Worker report names inspected sources, evidence, limits, and absorption candidates.
phases.stop_condition: Codex scan report is imported or bridged.

phases.title: Claude Scan
phases.action: Launch a read-only Claude scan over configured external mounts.
phases.verifier: Worker report names inspected sources, evidence, limits, and absorption candidates.
phases.stop_condition: Claude scan report is imported or bridged.

phases.title: Adversarial Synthesis
phases.action: Use the selected critic brand to challenge the overlap, duplication risk, unsafe imports, and false-rigor failure modes.
phases.command: uaf adversarial-review --from codex --brand {{combo_brand}} --mission {{mission_id}} --scope "<analysis scope>" --prompt "Adversarially review the absorption matrix and push back on duplication, unsafe imports, false rigor, and missing verifier contracts." --profile {{profile}} --timeout-ms 0
phases.verifier: Red-team report is reviewed and accepted or converted into change requests.

phases.title: Absorption Matrix
phases.action: Turn source findings into keep, absorb, defer, or reject decisions.
phases.verifier: Decisions include scope, owner surface, verifier, and explicit non-goals.
phases.stop_condition: Matrix can drive implementation without reopening the whole scan.

phases.title: Implementation Plan
phases.action: Break accepted candidates into implementation phases and verifier gates.
phases.command: uaf workflow start --template implement-review-fix --mission {{mission_id}} --summary "Implement accepted absorption candidates"
phases.verifier: Plan has bounded phases and a test/review closeout path.
